Title: A+ Study Tracker 40% unlock gate silently blocks all ticket/lab/capstone/CLI-lab work
Evidence: Both observed live and confirmed in code
Relevant Code Files: backend/app/services/a_plus_access.py; backend/app/routers/tickets.py, labs.py, capstones.py, cli_labs.py, evidence.py
Impact: Student: cannot do any Week 1 hands-on work as designed until ~9 hours of unrelated video-watching is done; no explanation given anywhere

Implementation Complexity: Low (single admin setting change; messaging is a small UI addition)
Launch Impact: Blocks the core loop before Week 0 begins
Confidence: High — reproduced live this session with real 403/threshold changes

Title: Week 1 curriculum content ordering (SUPERSEDED - false premise; see Pre-Week-0 sprint)
Evidence: Corrected 2026-07-21: MOD-000/MOD-001 both live-mapped to week 1; live GET /api/students/me/week-plan?week=1 returned 3 real lessons (Anatomy of a Good Ticket, Meet the Command Line, plus orientation). No new lesson was needed or written.
Impact: Real bug found instead: MOD-001's Learning Path prerequisite on MOD-000 was permanently unsatisfiable (MOD-000 has no lesson-linked quiz/ticket/lab, so its mastery is stuck at 0%), producing a cosmetic-only frontend lock. Recommended Outcome: Fixed via Alembic migration 0030_week_gating_data_fixes.py: nulled MOD-001.prerequisite_module_id. No new lesson content was written; writing one would have duplicated existing, already-correct curriculum.
